reviews.comment: This class was a LOT of material, but all of the notes were literally in the slides. Lab is super easy and really nothing to stress about, but it is a LOT of info. Personally, I didn't have to use the textbook I just read the slides and I got by in the class. Would highly recommend!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Benedik is knowledgeable and experienced in microbiology. Lectures are content-dense (attendance optional) and closely follow the textbook, with many PowerPoint slides on Canvas. Exams are multiple-choice and free-response, concept-focused, with no practice exams, so staying on top of the material is important. Grading expectations are clear.

Dr. Benedik has a great personality and is really awesome at lectures. His exams are not too difficult, I believe the averages were a little low because he is not the best at explaining what he expects on the exam. I learned a ton in this class, combine paying attention in class with rereading the slides, you will do well. He also curves!

This was a really interesting course. It was online and consisted of 13 weekly discussion boards (have to post 5 times) and 13 weekly written assignments. If you engage in the discussion and do your assignments, it was an easy A. Easy grader and you learn a ton about synthetic biology.
